lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: description: Host a static site on this repo's GitHub Pages. Use when uploading a folder with index.html, including a comprehende export, or when a pull request needs a hosted review URL.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: Copy a static site onto this repository's `gh-pages` branch so it has a public URL.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: 1. Confirm the folder contains `index.html`. Done when that file is present. If it is missing, use the built site (a comprehende `export` out dir).

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: 2. Pick dest. A pull request they named, or `gh pr view --json number` when hosting that review, uses `--pr`. Anything else uses `--name` with a lowercase slug they named, or one you make. Done when you have exactly one of `--pr` or `--name`.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: 3. From the repo root, run `node --experimental-strip-types .agents/skills/pages/scripts/pages-review.ts publish --dir <folder>` with that dest. `--dir` may live outside the work tree. Other flags: append `--help`. Done when the command prints a URL.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: A 404 at the URL means Pages is off. Enable once in the GitHub repo: Settings, Pages, Deploy from a branch, `gh-pages`, `/`. The publish already succeeded.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: `node --experimental-strip-types .agents/skills/pages/scripts/pages-review.ts prune --pr <n>` removes one site; `prune --ttl-days 30` removes every site older than 30 days. `.github/workflows/pages-reviews.yml` runs both: on pull request close and daily.
